Design scope

What the architecture covers

Set the right framework before individual buildings are designed. We organize land use, plots, roads, open space, utilities, approvals and growth as one plan.

01Land use structureBalance residential, commercial, civic and open-space requirements.
02Plot subdivisionSet plot sizes, blocks and development parcels around the project model.
03Road hierarchyOrganize main access, local streets, service routes and pedestrian movement.
04Utilities and drainageReserve practical corridors for water, sewerage, power and stormwater.
05Open space networkConnect parks, landscape, community areas and natural site features.
06Phasing strategySequence infrastructure and development so the plan can grow coherently.

Eight-step process

From brief to buildable drawings

Each stage closes the important decisions before the next one begins.

01

Brief and site analysis

Confirm the project brief, review the site and record the constraints that shape the design.

02

Concept planning

Test layout, zoning, access and movement before the architectural form is fixed.

03

Form and 3D studies

Develop the exterior character and review key views, proportions and materials.

04

Design development

Resolve dimensions, openings, levels, materials and the key technical decisions.

05

Working drawings

Prepare coordinated plans, sections, elevations and the agreed construction details.

06

Authority submission

Develop the required architectural set around the relevant approval process.

07

Infrastructure and approvals

Align roads, utilities, drainage, landscape, phasing and authority requirements.

08

Final handover

Issue the agreed drawing package for pricing, coordination and construction.

Architecture fees

A clear range before the proposal

The fee covers architectural design and drawings. Construction, interior design and fit-out are separate unless they are added to the brief.

IncludedSite analysis, land-use concept, movement plan, infrastructure coordination and planning drawings.
Final feeFull plans commonly begin around PKR 1M. Large or complex schemes can reach PKR 5M+ depending on area and approvals.
Separate costsGovernment charges, surveys and third-party specialist fees are confirmed separately where needed.
Indicative design feeFrom PKR 500K

Full plans commonly begin around PKR 1M. Large or complex schemes can reach PKR 5M+ depending on area and approvals.

After architecture

Carry the idea into the interior

Individual buildings can move into Woodex Architecture after the framework is approved. Interior design and fit-out follow at building level.
